title: Maximum Distance to Closest Person
description: A row of seats is represented by a binary array `seats`, where 1 is occupied and 0 is empty. Choose an empty seat to maximize the distance to the nearest occupied seat. Return that maximum distance. Input: `seats`. Output: the best nearest-seat distance.
constraints: At least one seat is occupied and at least one seat is empty
hints: Maintain the prefix or window information needed to count candidate ranges.
Check repeated values, extreme bounds, and cases with no valid segment.
